title: task verify CLI cannot retain a check longer than two minutes
observation: The `hunch task verify` CLI ran the wrapped command with a fixed 120 s timeout and exposed no --timeout flag; the engine API capped timeoutMs at 600 s. A repository whose full suite takes ~30 minutes could not retain that run as an observed check: the wrapper recorded exit_code null / timed_out true. RESOLVED 2026-09-12 by PR #174 (merged 90c8057, shipped in 1.32.1): `hunch task verify <id> --timeout <seconds> -- <cmd>` up to six hours (MAX_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS), default still two minutes; long suites are now retained as passed checks (used the same day on the Sofia suite).
evidence: 1.32.1 CHANGELOG: task verify --timeout up to six hours
